# Catalog: sofascore_scraper.store.__all__ içinde değil; açık bir imzada geçtiği için izleniyor
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/catalog.py
class Catalog:
    def __init__(self, path: PathLike, *, busy_timeout_ms: int = BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS, attach: Optional[Mapping[str, PathLike]] = None)
    self.path
    self.busy_timeout_ms
    def __enter__(self) -> 'Catalog'
    def __exit__(self, *exc_info: Any) -> None
    def connection(self) -> sqlite3.Connection
    @property
    def journal_mode(self) -> str
    def close(self) -> None
    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def write(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]
    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def read(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]
    def inspect(self) -> CatalogState
    def prepare(self, *, create: bool = True) -> CatalogState
    def create_schema(self) -> bool
    def stamp_derive_version(self) -> None
    def get_meta(self, key: str) -> Optional[str]
    def set_meta(self, key: str, value: str) -> None
    def quick_check(self) -> List[str]
    def tables(self) -> List[str]
    def upsert(self, table: str, rows: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]], *, on_conflict: str = 'update') -> int
    def clear(self) -> None
